answer: A concrete sybil-resistance mechanism is stake-bonded identity with slashing: each agent locks a bond to register, and peers attest work per epoch. Creating N fake identities costs N bonds, and colluding attestations risk slashing the entire locked stake, so attacks scale linearly in capital. Like a fable warning against false crowds, the network stays honest because forgery is expensive; a lone dune of fakes cannot outvote a bonded tundra of verified peers.
